full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white interior portrait shows a young person standing near a dark mantel or cabinet in a room crowded with framed paintings. The figure stands at the right of center, facing the viewer with a slight lean and both hands tucked into trouser pockets. Short dark tousled hair frames a calm, somewhat tired face. A crisp white shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms and an open collar contrasts with a fitted black waistcoat and dark trousers. The wall behind is layered with pictures of varied sizes: a large seascape or waterside painting with masts dominates the upper left, while smaller dark portraits and landscapes fill the area above and behind the figure. Ornate frames and patterned wall covering create a dense vertical grid. A narrow ledge below the largest picture holds small indistinct objects, and its dark front panel occupies much of the lower left. Light enters from the left, brightening the big framed image and the person's white sleeves, face, and collar. The right background and lower clothing fall into charcoal shadow. The room is visibly lived-in but not cluttered with loose items; its density comes from frames, moldings, and dark surfaces. Fine photographic grain and moderate contrast preserve detail in the blacks. The relaxed stance forms a simple upright anchor against the busy wall, and the pale shirt separates the figure from the overlapping pictures. The portrait feels quiet, informal, and slightly introspective.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白室内肖像呈现一位年轻人站在深色壁炉架或柜体旁，室内挂满带框画作。人物在中央偏右，身体微倚，面向观者，双手插在裤袋里。短而略乱的深发围住平静、稍显疲惫的脸。白衬衫袖子卷至前臂，衣领敞开，对照贴身黑马甲和深色长裤。身后墙面叠着大小不一的图画：左上大画似是有桅杆的海岸或水边景，较小的深色肖像和风景填满人物上方及身后。雕饰相框和带纹样墙纸组成密集竖向网格。大画下方窄架搁着几个难辨小物，柜体深色正面占左下大部。光从左侧进入，提亮大幅框画及人物白袖、面孔与衣领。右后方和下部衣服进入炭灰阴影。室内显得有人生活，却没有满地散物；密度来自相框、线脚和深色表面。细摄影颗粒与适中反差保留黑部细节。放松姿态在繁忙墙面前形成简单竖向锚点，浅衬衫把人影从相叠画框中分离。肖像安静、非正式，略带内省。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome interior photograph balances a relaxed upright focal silhouette against a dense grid of framed rectangular tones. One pale shirtlike area and a large light image plane pull the eye from the surrounding charcoal walls and dark lower mass. Side light from the left gives soft modeling to the central face-like form and brightens a few broad vertical folds, while the right side recedes into shadow. Repeated frame edges, moldings, and small dark pictures create measured background texture without motion. The photographic grain is fine, and black values retain layered detail rather than collapsing to flat fill. The composition feels intimate and informal, with a near-frontal figure standing slightly off-center and a visually crowded yet orderly environment. Quiet tonal transitions and restrained highlights set its contemplative pace.
style_prompt_zh: 单色室内摄影以放松的竖向焦点剪影平衡密集的带框矩形明暗网格。一块浅衬衫般区域与一片大浅色图面，把目光从周围炭灰墙和深色下部团块中拉出。左侧光给中央脸形柔和塑形，并提亮几道宽竖向褶面，右侧则退入阴影。重复框边、线脚和小幅深色图画建立有节制的背景纹理，而无运动感。摄影颗粒细，黑色明度仍有层次细节，并未压成平涂。构图亲密、非正式，近正面人物略偏中央，环境视觉拥挤却有秩序。安静明暗过渡与克制高光确定沉思节拍。
theme_en: A young person in a vest standing amid framed paintings
theme_zh: 年轻人穿马甲站在挂满画作的室内
name: Lewis Morley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
